settings.title: Questions retailers often ask
settings.subtitle: Quick answers about retailer pricing, wishlists, orders and support.

items.question: How do I view my trade pricing?
items.answer: Sign in with your verified retailer account to view account pricing and available quantity slabs.

items.question: Can I save products before placing an order?
items.answer: Yes. Use the heart icon to build a wishlist and return to those products whenever you are ready.

items.question: Where can I track my orders?
items.answer: Open My Account and select Orders to review order status and available payment details.

items.question: How can I get help with a product or order?
items.answer: Use the Contact page to send your question to the support team with the relevant product or order details.
